name: Unending Drive
description: Drive forward with a will that has no remaining limit to turn it back and strike the one chosen mark.

name: Unending Mantle
description: Wrap the nearest allies in a mantle of will that has outlasted every ending and lends them that endurance.

name: Pulse Recalled
description: Recall the stopped pulse of a fallen ally by refusing the stopping; the window is short and every use is a heavy consequence.

name: Ending Refused
description: Refuse the hold of an aura of despair or a command to yield so it passes through the user without effect.

name: Boundless Recoil
description: Draw a mighty blow into the boundless will and return it at the striker in one stroke of equal weight.

name: Limit Refusal
description: Refuse a limit laid on the user's cultivation by a seal or a crushing pressure and push past it.

name: Beyond Surge
description: Surge past the point where the fight should have ended and bow the foe's will under the blow.

name: Everlasting Uplift
description: Pour a deep unending firmness into every ally in the field for as long as the user stands.

name: Unending Heart
description: The treatise's closing school move that strikes the foe and fills the allies with a heart that does not end at a depth set by the user's reserve.

name: Beyond Standard
description: Set a standard of will above the company that no ending is allowed to cross at a strength set by the user's reserve.

name: Ending Decree
description: Speak a decree that no ending will be accepted here and press the decree on foes and allies alike at a weight set by the user's reserve.

name: Willstorm
description: Loose the full storm of an unending will over a field and break every hostile stance within the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Deathless Heart
description: The one thing no cultivation energy mechanic explains: in the span of a single breath a death already dealt to the user or a bound ally is refused outright and the stroke is as if it had never fallen; every use is a Part 27 consequence event.

name: Refusal Entire
description: The one thing no cultivation energy mechanic explains: the user refuses one named act of the world and for a single exchange that act does not take place though no barrier turned it; every use is a Part 27 consequence event.
